messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/chat/completions (us-west) - p99 > 2.0s over 5m. triggered=2390001234. route=chat-completions, models=[mistral-8x, gpt-compat]. link: https://monitoring/relevant/2390001234
jordan: ugh, seeing a ton of heads-down p95/p99 noise from this rule. paging is noisy even though customer impact looks limited. who’s oncall?
maria: I’m oncall. I can take a look. initial glance: p99 jumps are correlated with a handful of long-context requests from a couple of customers doing A/B tests. p95 only nudged. seems like rule is too broad (global across all models/routes).
sam: thx. current alert is a single global rule: /v1/chat/completions p99(5m)>2s -> page. we should split by model-group and route. also consider customer_tier label so enterprise pages always.
akshay: agree with split. also want KV cache hit-rate and model-shard utilization on the dashboard — might explain p99 regressions.
jordan: two asks: 1) reduce pager noise for non-enterprise traffic, 2) don’t accidentally mute enterprise pages.
maria: quick mitigation idea: add temporary squelch for customer_tier != "enterprise" and change severity=warning for those buckets. small PR possible. example pseudo-rule below: 
```
# pseudo alert patch
alert: ChatCompletionsLatencyP99PerModel
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[10m])) by (le, model, route)) > 2.0
for: 5m
labels:
  customer_tier: "{{ customer_tier }}"
  model_group: "{{ model_group }}"
  severity: "pager" # override to warning for non-enterprise via alertmanager silences
```

sam: small tweak: make p99 use a 10m window to avoid transient spikes. keep p95 at 5m for more sensitive ops detection. that should reduce chattiness.
lucy: fyi from CS: two enterprise customers reported timeouts in the last hour (tickets #9274 and #9276). do not silence enterprise pages. I’ll collect traces and attach.
akshay: perfect — so rule plan: split by model_group, set per-model thresholds (heavy vs light), p99 uses 10m, p95 uses 5m, and route label applied. implement alertmanager route so severity=page only if customer_tier==enterprise or model_group in critical set.
jordan: proposed thresholds (initial):
- heavy models (avg_seq > 2048): p99 > 2.5s (10m), p95 > 900ms (5m)
- medium models: p99 > 2.0s, p95 > 800ms
- small/short-context models: p99 > 1.5s, p95 > 600ms
these are just starting points — we’ll iterate after a 24h observation window.
maria: I’ll open a PR with those changes and a short playbook for oncall. PR will: split rules by model_group, add customer_tier label, bump p99 window to 10m, and add alertmanager routing to suppress non-enterprise pagers.
sam: I’ll make the dashboard changes: add panels for per-model p95/p99 over 1h/24h, KV cache hit-rate, request-length distribution, and concurrent-shard-utilization. will link dashboards in PR.
lucy: CS will post the two enterprise traces here and a summary of user impact so we can validate thresholds.
akshay: also adding a quick check in CI to prevent accidental re-add of the old global rule (we had that accidentally flip earlier).
jordan: action items summary: 
- maria: open PR to split rules + alertmanager route (owner)
- sam: dashboard panels & link (owner)
- akshay: squelch/route implementation + CI guard (owner)
- lucy: collect enterprise traces and post here (owner)
- jordan: follow up in 24h and decide final thresholds

maria: opened PR at 2390001280 -> https://git/repo/pull/482 (patch includes per-model thresholds: heavy p99 2.5s, med 2.0s, light 1.5s; p95 set to 600-900ms; p99 uses 10m). request review from @sam and @akshay.
sam: reviewing now. suggestion: bucket models by avg_seq_length in a label pipeline rather than hardcoding names — more robust as new models roll in.
akshay: good call. will add a small service that annotates model_group at ingestion so alerts/dashboards can be model-agnostic.
lucy: posted traces (tickets 9274, 9276) and brief: both affected enterprise sessions had >3s completions and one retransmit. attaching logs.
incident-bot: DEPLOY: alert rules updated and deployed by ci-deploy-bot at 2390001290. link: https://ci/deploy/2390001290
jordan: great, thanks all. Schedule a quick post-deploy check at +1h and a dashboard review tomorrow 10:00 PST. we should also add runbook steps: how to temporarily bump p99 window to 15m for noisy events and how to add tenant-level exceptions.
akshay: will add CI test and a short doc snippet in the runbook repo.
maria: closing this thread for now — we’ll reopen if enterprise pages fire. thx everyone :thumbsup:
